title: Seminar on Economic Choices: Comparing Sources with Limitations · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short essay (about 150 words) comparing two sources of information about a local economic issue (e.g., food prices, housing costs). Explain the limitations of each source and state which one you find more reliable. Use complex and simple sentences, and include at least one conditional, one concessive, and one reason clause.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
